boundaries: The input is the complete published monthly expenditure extract, not HMRC's complete original general ledger. The Equity offset and category accounts are an explicit analysis model.
Source labels identify published strings, not independently resolved legal entities or original publisher master IDs. Both modeled legs carry the same source attribution.

All 42 area reports have actual native dimension-filtered certificates, replay and standalone proofs. Supplier coverage is exact source-to-native-to-export attribution plus gross/net comparisons, without claiming a party-filtered TB proof surface.
Native source binding covers every normalized CSV leg/package member. Original raw rows, fields, dates and signs were checked separately; absent publisher activity is not reconstructed.
Later empty modeled months carry source-month balances only to satisfy the explicit historical span. They make no statement about HMRC's actual later activity.
The trusted checkpoint key belongs to this local test book, not the department. No audit opinion, fraud finding, independent human review, whole-workspace test gate or bead closure is claimed.

document_custody.boundary: Automated distinct local fixture principals exercise review and approval law; these are not independent human reviewers or publisher attestations.

execution.timing_source: Runner time.monotonic interval. One shared-development-host execution, not a controlled performance comparison.

failure_and_repair.cause: Native dimension and party commands prepend default-key text to the full 64-character source identity, producing 86-byte dimension keys and 70-byte party keys beyond the 64-byte key bound.
failure_and_repair.correction: Pass explicit --key equal to the existing 64-byte SHA256 code, whose input includes profile/dataset/kind/exact-label, for both registrations. Preserve each full source name and code; do not truncate identities, re-pin source bytes or change native limits.
failure_and_repair.verification: The regression covers both registrations. Fresh run 2 registered all 202 identities, completed the full native import and passed all proofs. Failed run 1 remains intact.

implementation.harness_basis: Existing optional attribution feature from acd0e07 plus the focused explicit registration-key correction recorded here.
implementation.helper_identity_observation: The correction was installed and tested before run 2 launch. These exact helper bytes were hashed after launch and remained unchanged through completion; no prelaunch helper-hash timestamp is asserted. The runner captured and guarded native executable identities before native execution.

independent_export_audit.dimension_controls: All 252 area/account and 449 supplier/account gross debit, gross credit and net cells independently rebuilt from the original cells.
independent_export_audit.method: Separate csv.DictReader/Decimal code read every original Windows-1252 cell, constructed the declared 12-row date groups, joined actual native prepared IDs and stage receipts, and compared every exported leg field. No production normalizer, checker or source oracle was imported.

source.acquisition: Fresh HTTPS retrieval through the supported public_spend.py prepare helper, with complete byte-count, SHA256, schema, date and exact source controls; preparation process exit 0 observed.
